description: The Marketing Engineer's runtime and write boundary (Guardrails G1, G2, G8), chosen in US-ME02. The launcher (src/bin/gr0wthlab) turns this file into a Codex permission profile and command-line flags, ignoring the Founder's own Codex configuration and rules. Why Codex, and the refused-write evidence: docs/spikes/us-me02-runtime-boundary.md.

filesystem.deny_why: Codex's :minimal system grant also makes /tmp and /var/tmp writable; denying them keeps every write inside the writable areas.

machine_overrides.GR0WTHLAB_CODEX_BIN: Absolute path of the codex executable; default: codex on the launcher's PATH.
machine_overrides.GR0WTHLAB_MANDU_DIR, GR0WTHLAB_REPTODAY_: Read-only checkout locations, as config/products.json describes.
